SCND attractors are still unfamiliar in the neural network studies and have not yet been observed in both artificial and biological neural systems. With numerical calculations of various kinds of statistical quantities in artificial neural network, dynamical characters of SCND attractors are strongly suggested to be observed also in neural systems experiments.
